title: Service Workers
definition: A Service Worker is a type of web worker. It is a JavaScript file that runs separately from the main browser thread, intercepting network requests, caching or retrieving resources, and delivering push messages.
simpleExplanation: A middleman between your website and the internet. If the internet dies, the middleman instantly hands the website a saved copy of the data.
